concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: The agreement expressly sets the Effective Date as 1 February 2027, distinct from the parties’ signing date.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Evaluating a possible minority investment by the Recipient in the Discloser's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch.
justifications: The agreement identifies this as the sole Permitted Purpose and specifies the transaction type, business, and project name.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: Although the disclosure window ordinarily ends on 31 January 2028, a valid termination notice closes it effective 30 November 2027.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: The parties designate the courts of Oslo as their contractual forum.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: The agreement identifies FjordSignal AS, registered in Norway, as the Discloser and a signatory party.
The agreement identifies Talus Ventures AB, registered in Sweden, as the Recipient and a signatory party.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: At the snapshot, LUMEN remains protected as a trade secret, SHORE’s prior-possession evidence covers only its older module, CEDAR’s authorized public release has not yet occurred, and BASALT’s only public posting resulted from a breach. ORACLE’s confirmation was late and had not been accepted by the snapshot, while MICA was independently developed before disclosure.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: Counting five Business Days after the 25 March oral disclosure, while excluding 26 and 29 March, gives 5 April as the final day for confirmation.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection was provisional from the oral disclosure on 25 march 2027 until the 5 april 2027, 17:00 utc confirmation deadline. the confirmation was sent on 5 april at 16:58 but reached the designated mailbox on 6 april at 09:05, so delivery was late; protection therefore lapsed after the deadline and remained absent until written acceptance on 8 april at 10:00, when it resumed prospectively only. protection was not continuous, and sending the confirmation did not meet the deadline.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection was provisional from the oral disclosure on 25 March 2027 until the 5 April 2027, 17:00 UTC confirmation deadline. The confirmation was sent on 5 April at 16:58 but reached the designated mailbox on 6 April at 09:05, so delivery was late; protection therefore lapsed after the deadline and remained absent until written acceptance on 8 April at 10:00, when it resumed prospectively only. Protection was not continuous, and sending the confirmation did not meet the deadline.
justifications: The oral-information rule ends provisional protection at the deadline if confirmation arrives late and permits only prospective restoration upon written acceptance. Delivery occurs on mailbox arrival, not when sent.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: Prior possession is established only for the smaller S-17 module incorporated in the package. The new branching map, thresholds, and complete package combination were not shown to have been possessed previously, so the entire package is not excluded.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The entire schedule was independently and lawfully released to the unrestricted public on this date, establishing the public-information exclusion for the complete asset from its release date.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin meets the employee, undertaking, security-check, and clean-room requirements. Marek is an employee of an Affiliate with more than 50% qualifying votes and all requirements effective by the snapshot; Oskar qualifies as a professional adviser and has the required security check and clean-room approval. The other listed people fail an applicable eligibility requirement.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: The Recipient can count its directly held 48% of votes plus a disjoint 4% covered by a presently effective irrevocable proxy at the snapshot. The revocable proxy and non-voting interests do not count.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Marek's undertaking and security check were effective by 10 September, but his named clean-room approval did not become effective until 14 September. The qualifying voting arrangements were operating on that date, so all applicable conditions were first met then.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: Because notice was initially prohibited, the deadline was the earlier of six continuous hours after the prohibition was lifted and the production time. Six hours after the prohibition was lifted at 11:20 on 5 July was 17:20 that day, earlier than the production time.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: The applicable deadline was 17:20 on 5 July, and the notice actually arrived at 17:55. Compelled-disclosure notices are measured at actual arrival, so the notice was 35 minutes late.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final binding narrowing order required all of P1 and only the non-privileged subsection P3A. P2 and P4 were withdrawn, and P3B was identified as privileged and outside the production duty.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The return request arrived on 22 November, earlier than the effective termination date, so the ten-Business-Day period began on the next eligible day. Excluding 25 and 26 November, the tenth Business Day was 8 December; restoring the copy did not restart the deadline.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: BK-1 may remain until the earlier of its scheduled overwrite on 30 December and 45 calendar days after the 22 November trigger. The scheduled overwrite is earlier, and restoration did not restart or alter either clock.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: The counsel-held segregated archive qualifies for the archival exception, BK-1 remains within its permitted backup period at the snapshot, and HOLD-1 is covered by a binding preservation order. WORK-1 is an overdue ordinary active copy, while NOTE-1 has no applicable retention exception.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: Deliberately recorded parameter values and reconstruction notes are excluded from residual-knowledge permission, and training a model using Confidential Information is prohibited without a separate signed licence. No such licence or retention arrangement covers NOTE-1.
